posts.text:
Not calling out @ContraPoints in particular, but there is a reason why people tend to only heavily criticize one side.

Take @ryancbeard for example. He made a "nuke" about me that's sitting at over 900,000 views right now. Obviously I disagree with the vast majority of it, but it's fairer than most. He announced he was going to make a video covering the weird snarker/lefty types, and was bullied so hard on just the announcement that he never even followed through with the video:
